claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the clips for holding all hair types and densities, from fine and thin to thick, curly, and 4C hair.
Many customers find the clips well made, durable, and good value for the price.
Several reviewers note the clips work well for sectioning hair during styling, cutting, coloring, and detangling.
A few customers report poor quality, with complaints about cheap shiny plastic, rigid hinges, hair indentations, and clips breaking within weeks.
Some reviewers mention the clips are branded 'Toni & Guy,' which was unexpected.
